newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ says no change in view of recovering economy.
newsitem.headline: BOJ says no change in view of recovering economy.

text.p: The Bank of Japan's assessment that the economy was recovering gradually has not changed, a senior bank official said on Tuesday.
The official, who briefed reporters on the BOJ's monthly economic report, said the current economic situation does not warrant a change in the assessment on the pace of the recovery.
The monthly report released on Tuesday said that the moderate economic recovery continues.
Capital spending was increasing steadily while personal consumption showed a moderate recovery trend, it showed.

Housing starts remained at a high level as individuals took advantage of low interest rates and also built houses before a scheduled rise in Japan's consumption tax to five percent from three percent in April.
"Current economic situations have not offered us factors which would make the BOJ consider a change in its assessment of the gradual pace of the recovery," he said.
